items.title: 60499_Garvin Bushell oral history interview
items.q: Cab sent me -- called me up and said would I like to join the band. That was in '35.

ctx.x: I did escape, yeah, soon as I could get away, because she'd have killed me, no kidding. I didn't go back to Louisville until she died, you know. I made sure I was with Calloway, and we were going to Louisville, and I said, "Does such an such a person --?" "Oh, no, she's dead." "Oh, well, I'll go then."
